recovery: optimizer states absent; deterministic replay14calls with per-call exact loss/recall/data and bitwise full weights comparison, then continue without optimizer reset

stopping_and_evaluation.resume: No optimizer states retained; replay same14calls; exact loss/recall/data and bitwise model weight gate before extension
stopping_and_evaluation.retain: Only current WA050 best; validate pending before superseding old best; no replay checkpoints
stopping_and_evaluation.final_best_utility: Run once if not already evaluated at same best step

retention: Only latest fresh-reload validated WA050 best; old WA050 best may be deleted only after replacement verified; all historical evidence retained
